Rákosmente (17. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

A large, mostly single-family-home outer district that saw a genuine, well-documented burglary wave from December 2024 into January 2025: residents on streets including Dallamos utca, Algír utca and Nemesbük utca reported repeated break-ins (crowbars on windows, fence-climbing, some incidents in daylight), and a 34,000-member local Facebook group organised informal resident street patrols in response — which themselves then created friction, including one reported incident of a volunteer aggressively pursuing an innocent commuter. Official police and neighbourhood-watch bodies had not publicly addressed the wave at the time of the main report. A genuinely current, still-unresolved property-crime concern rather than a violent one. Sources checked: Index.hu, 28 Dec 2024 (burglary wave, resident vigilante patrols); Metropol.hu, Jan 2025 (continuing burglary attempts).
